important_limitations: Contextual values are not ordinary-food values and do not count toward the 109/119 verified ordinary-food metric.
Irilone 0.06 mg/g is secondary-source reported and its primary numeric row was not independently verified.
Amentoflavone percentages are for dried powdered Viburnum tissues; the study reports n=3 analytical measurements from collected material, not a market-sample series or independent population survey.
7-Methoxyflavanone and the exact pentamethoxyflavone have no verified quantitative matrix value; no estimate or zero was entered.
